fusions.name: Braided Lash
fusions.desc: You snap the strands braided round the staff's head across an enemy, dealing 7 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Tangles
fusions.desc: You whirl the staff and its strands unspool, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each has a 50% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Between
fusions.desc: You pay out strands from the staff in a line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward, and anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Loose Strand
fusions.desc: When you strike, a loose strand whips from the staff to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
